title: Interactive visualizations for computer networks courses
description:
Self-contained, interactive HTML visualizations for teaching computer networks at undergraduate level: line coding and bit time, transmission and propagation delays, space-time and timing diagrams, layering and encapsulation, queueing and packet drops in a router, DNS names, zone delegation and query resolution, and persistent HTTP with and without pipelining.

Every visualization is a single HTML file with no dependencies that works offline, and is available in Spanish and English. The repository also includes the modular source of the larger pieces, a machine-readable catalogue (catalog.yml) with summaries, concepts and formulas, and the design template of the delay lab.

Developed for the course Arquitectura de Redes I (Network Architecture I) at the University of Alcalá, Spain, and published at edelahozuah.github.io.
